inference.multiple_comparison_correction: Holm family-wise correction across eight predeclared comparisons
inference.non_significance_policy: non-significance is not interpreted as equivalence
inference.paired_test: two-sided paired sign-flip permutation test on dataset mean regret
inference.seed_aggregation: mean regret within dataset before resampling

target.positive_action: graph only when selected-graph test accuracy exceeds selected-MLP test accuracy by more than the margin
target.tie_policy: all gaps less than or equal to the practical margin map to mlp
